revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 12.4% (716,924 vs 637,959); FY24 11.0%. Fade from ~11% to 7% as scale grows.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 11.2% (79,975/716,924), FY2024 10.8%; modest expansion from AWS/advertising mix, tempered by AI depreciation.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: blended effective rate below 21% US statutory given credits; not taken from a filing tool, reviewer should verify against the 10-K tax note.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A/revenue 9.2% (65,756/716,924), rising as heavy capex depreciates.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 18.4% of revenue (131,819), FY2024 13.0%; assume gradual normalization to 16% average over the forecast.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.2 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~10.2% cost of equity; debt ~$69B is small vs equity so weight ~5% at ~5% pre-tax cost; WACC ~9.7%. Beta is an assumption, not looked up.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 68,851 - cash 86,810 - short-term investments 36,219 (acc. 0001018724-26-000004); negative = net cash
